definitions.explanation: To physically handle or manage something with care.
To stock or sell products; to provide services for a particular area.

definitions.gloss: to treat, to deal with (a person or matter)
definitions.explanation: To treat or deal with someone or something in a particular way.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Compound verb: ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ + ⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧. Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{扱|あつか}う (handle X / deal with X).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing state. {取|と}り⟦{扱|あつか}って→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'deals with' or 'carries (products).'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{扱|あつか}う (handle carefully)
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{扱|あつか}う (carry products)
- ⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧ (handle with care)
- ⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧ (instruction manual)

NOUN FORM: ⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧ is commonly used as a noun meaning 'handling' or 'treatment.'
